entities.name: Godsend
entities.description: Swordspear wielded by Elspeth Tirel on Theros, reforged from the Sword of Chaos.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who wielded Godsend, was killed by Heliod, and later became an Archangel.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God who reforged the sword and later stabbed Elspeth with it.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God who raised arms against Heliod and crafted the Sword of Chaos.

entities.name: Polukranos, World Eater
entities.description: Hydra whose resting place was damaged and who fell to Theros.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God who helped seal Polukranos under the Nessian Forest.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: Foe Elspeth defeated in Nyx by stabbing him with Godsend.

entities.name: Underworld of Erebos
entities.description: Place where the dying Elspeth was confined.

events.summary: Purphoros and Heliod clash, damaging Nyx and sending Polukranos falling to Theros, where Nylea and Heliod seal him.
events.quote: the hydra fell to Theros where it was sealed by Nylea and Heliod under the Nessian Forest

events.summary: Elspeth, newly arrived on Theros, grasps the falling Sword of Chaos and planeswalks away.
events.quote: She saw the Sword of Chaos falling from the sky, grasped it, and planeswalked away.

events.summary: Heliod reforges the sword into the Godsend and Elspeth uses it to defeat Polukranos.
events.quote: Elspeth used her new weapon to defeat the awakened Polukranos.

events.summary: Elspeth defeats Xenagos in Nyx, but Heliod stabs her with Godsend, which shatters; she is confined to the Underworld.
events.quote: he stabbed her with the sword spear, which shattered afterward.

events.summary: After escaping the Underworld and becoming an Archangel, Elspeth conjures a facsimile of the Sword of Chaos.
events.quote: Elspeth conjured a facsimile of the Sword of Chaos

relations.note: He crafted the Sword of Chaos that became Godsend.
relations.quote: he crafted the Sword of Chaos

relations.note: He stabbed her with the sword spear.
relations.quote: he stabbed her with the sword spear, which shattered afterward.
Elspeth also defeated Xenagos , stabbing him with Godsend.
when the God Purphoros raised arms against Heliod
